The note which I just sent you suggested opening the TTY, in order
to do more clever output, by a line like
    (OPEN '((TTY) FOO BAR) '(OUT IMAGE SINGLE))
this should have been
    (OPEN '((TTY) FOO BAR) '(OUT IMAGE TTY))
